bookingOpens: Online through Guestplan on the restaurant's website, where tables can also be booked with an overnight stay or the Thursday 'Dine & Dream' package. A €150 deposit is taken when booking and taken off the bill on the night. Lunch starts at 12pm and dinner at 7pm, with everyone arriving at the same time.
groups: A private room seats up to 14 for lunch, dinner or a seminar; Thursday and Friday lunch is for events and private groups only. Call or email info@willemhiele.be.
